claim_ceiling: Synthetic calibration campaign plan only. No physical survey, calibration implementation, field route, DAS reproduction or measured accuracy is claimed.

scenarios.name: Known lab path with independent length reference
scenarios.conditions: Known endpoint, measured patch leads, known physical fibre path and independent length truth.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Compare optical range and physical fibre chainage; preserve residuals and uncertainty.

scenarios.name: Surveyed route anchors with declared CRS
scenarios.conditions: Known fibre route; independently surveyed tie points; declared horizontal CRS and vertical datum status.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Calculate route-station and geographic residuals against independent survey truth.

scenarios.name: Patch lead and launch offset not represented
scenarios.conditions: Interrogator reports optical range but input omits known patch/launch lead offset.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not issue physical fibre chainage or geography until the offset is accounted for.

scenarios.name: Slack loops and service coils
scenarios.conditions: Fibre includes unmeasured slack loops and coils that decouple optical length from route distance.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Preserve alternative path-length hypotheses and require a measurement or bound before high-confidence placement.

scenarios.name: Fibre endpoint direction reversed
scenarios.conditions: Calibration expects endpoint A to B but the actual interrogator path is reversed.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject the geographic transform and preserve the raw chainage reference only.

scenarios.name: Splice changed after approved calibration
scenarios.conditions: A splice or reroute changed physical optical path while an older calibration remains referenced.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Invalidate all dependent transforms and observations for geographic use; retain old revision for replay.

scenarios.name: Branched or multiplexed optical topology
scenarios.conditions: Several fibre spans or branches share an interrogator path and mapping is not unique.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Retain candidate span/path alternatives; do not invent a single physical route.

scenarios.name: Missing horizontal CRS or axis-order metadata
scenarios.conditions: Survey coordinates exist but CRS or axis-order metadata is absent.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Allow fibre-relative or survey-local result only; no geographic coordinate.

scenarios.name: Latitude/longitude or easting/northing axis swap
scenarios.conditions: Input geometry axis order conflicts with declared CRS and known control points.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Detect the mismatch with independent control; reject transform rather than silently swapping values.

scenarios.name: Incompatible vertical datum or coordinate epoch
scenarios.conditions: 3D geometry combines incompatible vertical reference or coordinate epoch without a verified transform.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not present a 3D position as comparable; require appropriate datum/epoch transformation.

scenarios.name: Insufficient survey anchors for route curvature
scenarios.conditions: Sparse tie points do not constrain a curved or multi-turn route to the claimed uncertainty.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Widen uncertainty or request additional anchors; do not extrapolate an unjustified precision.

scenarios.name: Self-near or overlapping route geometry
scenarios.conditions: Two route sections are geographically close but distinct in topology and chainage.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Use route topology and independent identity; spatial proximity alone cannot identify the correct span.

scenarios.name: Repair with new as-built and new calibration
scenarios.conditions: A repair changes fibre path; new as-built survey, endpoint identity, route revision and calibration receipt are present.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Accept only against the new revision; preserve explicit supersession and independent check.

scenarios.name: Route position known but owner asset unresolved
scenarios.conditions: Geographic location is calibrated but no owner-issued identity or permitted asset association exists.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Report geographic observation without attributing it to a specific cable, duct or owner asset.

scenarios.name: Nominal uncertainty intervals under-cover independent truth
scenarios.conditions: Held-out independent control points fall outside claimed 95 percent intervals more often than allowed by pre-registered acceptance criteria.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Fail uncertainty qualification; do not make high-confidence geography claims.

scenarios.name: Same chainage value from different fibre identities
scenarios.conditions: Two distinct fibre IDs produce the same numeric chainage and one is incorrectly selected by value alone.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Require exact fibre identity and revision binding; chainage is not globally unique.

global_controls: Optical range, physical fibre chainage, route station, geographic position and asset attribution are distinct claims.
Every transform is bound to exact fibre identity, route revision, interrogator configuration, endpoint and direction.
A missing, stale or incompatible transform cannot yield a high-confidence geographic coordinate.
Independent truth must not be generated by the candidate calibration algorithm.
Route topology and asset identity cannot be inferred from geometric proximity alone.
Superseded transformations remain immutable and are retained for replay.
Uncertainty and calibration interval coverage are evaluated on held-out independent controls.
Synthetic campaign plans are not measured observations or field survey results.
